title: Vintage Nolan Ryan Texas Rangers 1991 Framed Photo Display Plaque
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Photos
descriptionText:
Used
Vintage pre owned condition. Frame shows light surface wear and small scuffs consistent with age. Glass is intact with no cracks noted. Backing paper shows age and wear with an original price sticker still present. Please review all photos for exact condition

This wall display features a large action photograph of Nolan Ryan pitching, two mounted Nolan Ryan baseball cards, a Texas Rangers logo emblem, and an engraved metal nameplate reading
Nolan Ryan
Texas Rangers
1991
The display is mounted on dark blue felt backing inside a decorative wood frame with carved detailing. Original backing board and wall hanger are present.
This is a classic early 1990s sports memorabilia piece and displays very well. A great item for Nolan Ryan collectors or Texas Rangers fans.
Measurements
Overall frame size
Approximately 20 inches wide x 16 inches tall
Frame depth
Approximately 1.25 inches
Contents included
Large Nolan Ryan action photo
Two Nolan Ryan baseball cards mounted
Texas Rangers logo emblem
Engraved metal nameplate
Wood frame with glass front
Original backing and hanger
